purpose: Prevent the property platform from converting a retrieved record directly into a legal conclusion without separating the observed record fact, the scope of that fact, the applicable legal proposition and the resulting legal effect.
record_fact_rules: Record what the source actually states or records.
Do not silently expand a register entry beyond its statutory scope.
Record document date, registration/dealing date and event date separately.
Record whether the fact is current or historical.
Record the exact property identifier used for matching.
Record uncertainty instead of resolving it by assumption.
legal_effect_rules: A recorded event is not automatically the same as its legal effect.
A transfer document is not automatically proof that registration occurred.
Succession entitlement is not automatically current registered ownership.
A registered charge is not ownership.
A map or plan is not automatically conclusive of every boundary issue.
A Registry of Deeds memorial is not automatically the complete deed or its complete legal effect.
A court document must be matched to the relevant property, parties, order and date before its effect is stated.

answer_contract.prohibited_shortcut: source → conclusion without an explicit fact and legal-proposition layer

guardrails: Never state an inferred legal conclusion as though it were a quoted or recorded fact.
Never convert user assertions into verified property facts.
Never use a current register entry as automatic proof of a historical state.
Never use a historical document as automatic proof of the current state.
Never omit material statutory conditions or exceptions.
If the legal effect requires another source, route to that source instead of guessing.
